mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, lowering discount rates and enhancing equity cash flow present value, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (p > 0.05) during FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 8.0% signals a strengthening labor market, boosting corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 8.0% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 8.0%, or returns are positive in non-8% drops.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movements in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate robust demand and supply growth, amplifying corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when both proxies rise together, or returns are positive when they don't.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) below 2.0% signals Federal Reserve easing, reducing policy tightness and boosting equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL falls below 2.0% in late-cycle expansion
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during CPIAUCSL declines below 2.0% in late-cycle periods, or returns are positive without such declines.

mechanism_narrative: Opposite movements in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and demand-side activity (RSAFS) signal tightening monetary policy, raising interest rates and compressing corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises >0.5% while RSAFS falls >5.0% in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS and RSAFS move oppositely, or returns are negative without such movements.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 3% indicates robust demand, enhancing corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) during sustained GDPC1 growth above 3%, or returns are positive without such growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals weakening supply chains, reducing corporate output and equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 in a month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) during INDPRO drops below 95.0, or returns are negative without such declines.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, persistent high federal funds rates above 4.5% signal aggressive policy, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly negative (p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5% in tightening periods, or returns are negative without such rates.
